# Noba

> Noba is a free, open platform providing high-quality, customizable psychology textbooks and educational resources for instructors and students.

Noba offers a curated library of psychology modules covering research methods, neuroscience, and social psychology, authored by leading academic researchers. The platform enables educators to browse, customize, and adopt ready-made textbooks while maintaining open educational standards.

## Key Topics

- Psychology education
- Open educational resources
- Free textbooks
- Customizable curriculum
- Neuroscience
- Social psychology
- Research methods
- Anxiety disorders
- Academic researchers
- Creative Commons licensing
- Psychology modules
- College teaching
- Peer-reviewed content

## Core Platform

- [Noba Homepage](https://nobaproject.com): Main entry point to Noba's free, open platform for high-quality psychology textbooks and educational resources
- [Browse Content](https://nobaproject.com/browse-content): Searchable library of psychology modules, research methods, and scientific inquiry content organized by topic
- [Ready-Made Textbooks](https://nobaproject.com/resources/ready-made-textbooks): Pre-assembled, customizable psychology textbooks and comprehensive instructor resources for classroom adoption

## Learning & Community

- [Noba Blog](https://nobaproject.com/blog): Articles on online learning, course onboarding, educational technology, and best practices for psychology instruction

## Contributing Authors & Researchers

- [Glenn Adams](https://nobaproject.com/authors/glenn-adams): Cultural and social psychology researcher at University of Kansas
- [Dora Angelaki](https://nobaproject.com/authors/dora-angelaki): Computational neuroscience researcher at Baylor College of Medicine
- [David H. Barlow](https://nobaproject.com/authors/david-h-barlow): Anxiety disorders researcher and distinguished professor at Boston University
- [Linda Bartoshuk](https://nobaproject.com/authors/linda-bartoshuk): Taste and sensory perception researcher, award-winning neuroscientist
- [Roy F. Baumeister](https://nobaproject.com/authors/roy-f-baumeister): Social psychology and self-control researcher at Florida State University
- [Mark E. Bouton](https://nobaproject.com/authors/mark-e-bouton): Learning and extinction researcher at University of Vermont
- [Brad J. Bushman](https://nobaproject.com/authors/brad-j-bushman): Aggression and media psychology research professor at Ohio State University
- [Sue Carter](https://nobaproject.com/authors/sue-carter): Oxytocin and social behavior neuroscience researcher
- [David B. Baker](https://nobaproject.com/authors/david-b-baker): History of psychology expert at University of Akron

## Optional - Additional Author Profiles

- [Hannah Boettcher](https://nobaproject.com/authors/hannah-boettcher): Anxiety and psychotherapy researcher at Boston University
- [Debi Brannan](https://nobaproject.com/authors/debi-brannan): Psychology faculty at Western Oregon University
- [Simona Buetti](https://nobaproject.com/authors/simona-buetti): Sensation and perception researcher at University of Illinois
- [Cristina Crego](https://nobaproject.com/authors/cristina-crego): Clinical psychology graduate student at University of Kentucky
- [J. David Dickman](https://nobaproject.com/authors/david-dickman): Neuroscience professor studying motion and spatial navigation
